task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and returns the total number of objects stored in that bucket, using boto3 and handling pagination with a paginator.
Create a JSON IAM policy document that allows read-only access (s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket) to a single S3 bucket named 'my-app-logs' and denies all other actions on that bucket.
Write a regex that matches valid AWS EC2 instance IDs (formatted as 'i-' followed by 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters) and captures the ID portion in a named group called 'instance_id'.
